messages:
jamie: heads up — product pushing 'smart-routing' beta next sprint, big enterprise ask. quick sim shows possible p99 tail increase. need SRE input on launch gating and prioritization tradeoffs.
meera: can you share rough RICE inputs? impact seems high (customer revenue), effort unknown, reliability risk probably medium-high.
sam: quick numbers from staging run: p99 from 180ms -> 250ms under 20% extra qps. kv cache hit dropped ~8%. not catastrophic but not negligible.
lisa: +1 on risk. suggest strict canary criteria: error budget burn <= 1% over canary window OR immediate rollback. also require no manual toil increase.
jamie: proposed sequence: 1) update RICE sheet with reliability penalty 2) timeboxed canary on 5% user traffic for 48h 3) if error budget burn >1% OR p99 delta >40% rollback 4) GA only after latency mitigations or dedicated routing pool.
meera: how do we fold reliability into RICE? maybe multiply Impact by (1 - ReliabilityPenalty) where ReliabilityPenalty ~ min(0.5, projected error_budget_burn).
sam: I'll run a tighter load test and add a small perf patch to see if p99 improves. can also try reduced batch size.
lisa: will draft the canary dashboard + alerts. thresholds: p99 > 1.4x baseline OR error_budget_burn > 1% -> pager. cost delta > 20% -> ops-review.
jamie: rollout policy snippet for the deployment: 
```
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  percent: 5
  window: 48h
  metrics:
    - name: p99_latency
      threshold: 1.4
    - name: error_budget_burn
      threshold: 0.01
    - name: cost_delta
      threshold: 0.2
  on_violation: rollback
```
meera: I like that. also propose we add a "Reliability adjustment" column in the RICE sheet so PMs account for SLO impacts up-front.
sam: assign me to run perf + short A/B on reduced batch size. will post results by EOD tomorrow.
jamie: i'll own rollback automation and the ops play. @lisa can you confirm dashboard by EOD? :thumbsup:
lisa: yup. i'll include a tiny runbook: rollback command + smoke checks.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: smart-routing/canary -> prod-cluster-a at 2026-05-12T10:30:00Z (initiated by jamie). monitoring hooks attached.
jamie: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after sam's numbers and the RICE update. keep this thread for quick sync. :white_check_mark:
